name: Marco Tiberio
description: Photographer of how people make and live in spaces: hospitality, architecture and interiors on commission, and research on shelter and migration. Based in Amsterdam.
statement: Spaces photographed for the people who will use them.
intro:
Architecture, interiors and hospitality: hotels, rooms, lobbies and workplaces, for hotel groups, architects and interior studios.

Based in Amsterdam, working across Europe.
research_statement: The places people build for themselves.
research_intro: Self-initiated work on shelter and migration, seen from the ground and from above: zines, satellite imagery, film and generative portraits.
bio:
Marco Tiberio is a documentary and typological photographer and visual artist based in Amsterdam. His main interest is to understand how human beings react to the changes in society and how they interact with it and the world they live in. Through photography he wants to find new ways of investigating topics in order to make them more accessible to a broader public and give them new interpretations.

In 2020 he has been a recipient of the [Stimuleringsfonds](https://stimuleringsfonds.nl/en/) to develop a photographic project about how society deals with memories of migrations and colonies during and after WW2.

Marco has been a guest teacher at the Academy of Architecture of Amsterdam.

entries.text: Guest lecturer, Akademie van Bouwkunst, Amsterdam
